## 🦎 ONLY LIZARD — The 1v9 Lizard
*Who needs a Yordle when you have raw reptilian power?*


Kled has been completely removed from the game. Skaarl is now fighting 1v9 on her own !!


**🌟 Features :**
- Solo Skaarl Model : Kled removed from the 3D mesh.

- Cleaned VFX : Removed floating weapon glows and trails + Red shield.

- Custom Assets : Dedicated loading screen, minimap icon & thumbnail.

Base Champion: Kled | Replaces: All Skin's
